summary: A 66-year-old Craig man on a two-person private trip in inflatable kayaks on the Yampa River hit a rock in Tepee Rapid and capsized; he wore a PFD but never resurfaced; body found at 11:40 a.m. Sunday July 16 about 3 miles downstream
location: Tepee Rapid, Yampa River, Dinosaur National Monument
responding_agency: Dinosaur National Monument staff; Moffat County Coroner
notes: Companion kayaked 24 miles downstream to Hells Canyon Ranch to report; Monument staff contacted ~9 p.m. Saturday; search launched Sunday morning; helicopter already on-site for a wildland fire assisted MERGED 2026-09-13 (run 391): NPT Teepee-Rapids account (same incident: 66-yo Craig man, 2-person private inflatable-kayak trip, ~2 p.m. Saturday capsize, body found Sunday 11:40 a.m. ~3 mi downstream, Moffat County Coroner) appended from search-index match. Run 648 merge: NPS dated news release (parent-opened; Michael Brinks, 2017-07-15, Tepee Rapid).
